the units of 25-30 residues, closed loops, are the basic elements of the protein structures.

the loop structure is a basic structural element of the globular protein, and its evolutionary conservation is the main factor of the protein structural stability.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
protein sequences are organized in a universal manner as loop fold structures.
globular proteins can be considered as loop folds, and that the loop folds can be encoded by a proteomic code.
globular proteins can be viewed as loop fold structures, the loops being organized as units of 25-35 residues, and the units being characterized by a limited number of sequence prototypes.

the units are not only a statistical feature of protein sequences but also an evolutionary unit of protein structure.
